1. HeroSection (default left) 2. AnatomySection — 3 MoatCardBright-style accent cards (white bg + 3px top accent + 48x48 icon + h3 + body + detail block) 3. Reference style for anatomy cards: read `src/components/home/work.tsx` MoatCardBright pattern.** For each anatomy card: - White bg, borderRadius 18, padding 28, SHADOW.soft - 3px top accent strip - Corner glow div (rgba accent at top-right) - 48x48 icon square in accent.glow gradient bg, accent border 25%, icon in accent color - h3 FONT.sans 19/600 onyx letterSpacing -0.015em marginBottom 10 - p FONT.sans 14 lineHeight 1.6 stoneDark - Detail block: accent.bg bg, borderRadius 12, padding `4px 16px`. Each row: flex justify space-between, padding 10px 0, dashed accent borderBottom (none on last). Label 11.5/500 stoneDark. Value 12/600 onyx. - whileHover y:-4 + SHADOW.card - Use ACCENT_MAP from `@/lib/brand` or define inline accentMap --- ## PAGE 1: `src/app/product/ai-design/page.tsx` — AI Design Studio **Metadata:** ```ts export const metadata: Metadata = { title: "AI Studio — Brief generator, reference assist, style transfer | InkOS", description: "Generate client briefs from a paragraph. Pull reference grids by style. Translate inspiration to the artist's hand. AI for the prep, not the work.", openGraph: { title: "InkOS AI Studio", description: "AI for the prep, not the work.", type: "website" }, alternates: { canonical: "https://inkos.studio/product/ai-design" }, }; ``` **Hero:** ```tsx ``` **Anatomy** (GRADIENT.sectionCool, SectionEyebrow "What it does" accent="amber" + h2 "Three tools, one prep flow." size sm): 1. (rust, Sparkles) "Brief generator" — "Client says 'koi sleeve, traditional, with cherry blossoms.' AI returns a structured brief: palette, line study, references, palette swatches, body placement notes. The artist edits, never starts from zero." Detail: [Generation time: ~12s] [Editable: every field] [Stored: on the project] 2. (amber, ImageIcon) "Reference assist" — "Pull a 9-grid of references by style, era, body part, palette. Filter your own portfolio first, then the wider library. Saves to the project." Detail: [Source: portfolio + library] [Tag: per project] [Export: 1-click PDF] 3. (sage, Zap) "Style transfer" — "Upload a client photo. Generate placement preview in your style. Not for the final work — for the conversation. Helps the client see it before the chair." Detail: [Use: client conversation] [Watermark: ON by default] [Output: png + svg path] **Visual:** PhotoBand height 460, gradient `linear-gradient(135deg, ${BRAND.rust} 0%, ${BRAND.amber} 50%, ${BRAND.sage} 100%)`, label "AI brief output · 'Koi sleeve · traditional · cherry blossoms' · 12s generation" **Stats:** ```tsx ``` **FAQ:** - "Does AI design replace the artist?" — "No. AI handles the prep work — brief structure, reference grids, conversation previews. The artist still draws every line. The work is the work." - "What model is behind it?" — "Claude for briefs, custom-tuned image models for references and previews. We never train on client data." - "Is the output watermarked?" — "Yes. All preview outputs include a 'preview only' watermark unless you explicitly export a final." - "Is this on the Studio plan?" — "AI Studio is on the Pro plan and above. Solo and Studio plans see a placeholder with upgrade CTA." - "Does it work for non-traditional styles (realism, neo-trad, geometric)?" — "Yes. The model is style-aware. Returns better results when you specify the style up front." **CTA:** ```tsx ``` --- ## PAGE 2: `src/app/product/messages/page.tsx` — Messages **Metadata:** ```ts export const metadata: Metadata = { title: "Messages — Omnichannel inbox: SMS, email, IG, WhatsApp | InkOS", description: "Every conversation, every channel, one inbox. SMS, email, Instagram, WhatsApp, in-app — all routed to one thread per client. Auto-replies. Templates. Internal notes.", openGraph: { title: "InkOS Messages", description: "Omnichannel inbox built for studios.", type: "website" }, alternates: { canonical: "https://inkos.studio/product/messages" }, }; ``` **Hero:** ```tsx ``` **Anatomy** (GRADIENT.sectionWarm, SectionEyebrow "How it works" accent="rust" + h2 "Three layers of one inbox." size sm): 1. (rust, MessageSquare) "Omnichannel routing" — "Every channel — SMS via Twilio, email via Resend, IG/Messenger via Meta, WhatsApp Business — lands in the same conversation thread. Per-client. Per-channel timestamps." Detail: [Channels: SMS · Email · IG · WhatsApp · In-app] [Threading: by client] [Provider: yours OR ours] 2. (amber, Zap) "Auto-replies + templates" — "Off-hours triage. Pricing inquiry templates. Aftercare DM templates. Tokenised: client name, studio name, booking link auto-injected. Studio voice, automated." Detail: [Templates: unlimited] [Tokens: 7 standard] [Trigger: by keyword OR off-hours] 3. (sage, Users) "Internal notes + assignment" — "Note thread separated from client thread. Assign to the right artist. @mention teammates. The behind-the-scenes that clients never see." Detail: [Notes: internal-only] [Assignment: per-message] [Mentions: in-app + email] **Visual:** PhotoBand height 460, gradient `linear-gradient(135deg, ${BRAND.amber} 0%, ${BRAND.rust} 100%)`, label "3-pane inbox · 4 channels · Asha · Marcus · Elena" **Stats:** ```tsx ``` **FAQ:** - "Do I need a Twilio / Meta / WhatsApp account?" — "Optional. Use yours and we route through it. Or use InkOS-provided numbers (Pro plan and above) — we handle the carrier setup." - "What's the auto-reply trigger?" — "Off-hours by default. Customisable: keyword match (pricing, aftercare, walk-in), inbox overflow, specific channels." - "Are internal notes ever sent to clients?" — "Never. Internal note thread is a separate column, server-side enforced. Clients only see the conversation thread." - "Can multiple artists share the inbox?" — "Yes. Assign per-conversation. @mention teammates. Conversation status (new / in progress / awaiting reply / closed)." - "Do you charge per-message?" — "We don't. Twilio / Meta / WhatsApp charge their standard rates if you use them. Each plan includes a generous monthly SMS allotment." **CTA:** ```tsx ``` --- ## Implementation - Both pages are server components with `metadata` - Use motion.div for whileInView reveals - All inline styles `as React.CSSProperties` - Lift MoatCardBright pattern from `src/components/home/work.tsx` for anatomy cards - For the anatomy section, use motion stagger + fadeUp on the 3-card grid - Section paddings: hero handled by HeroSection (100/80). Other sections: paddingTop 100, paddingBottom 100. PhotoBand visual section: paddingTop 80 paddingBottom 80. ## Icons to import per page - AI Studio page: Sparkles, ImageIcon, Zap (lucide-react) - Messages page: MessageSquare, Zap, Users (lucide-react) ## Verification After both files: `cd "/Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Boldteq App/Marketing Site/InkOS" && pnpm run type-check`. Report PASS or paste errors. WRITE THE 2 FILES NOW.
